messages:
sarah-support: Heads-up — MerchantCo inbound SLA ask via Jeff. They want 99.99% uptime for the hosted offering + P99 latency 100ms for standard generate (<=512 tokens). Sales wants confirmation by EOD.
jeff-sales: MerchantCo will sign if we commit to those SLOs + 24/7 priority phone support. Need rough cost delta. cc @maria-product
maria-product: tagging @alex-eng @leo-ml. We need feasibility, cost ballpark, and proposed escalation/routing (Hosted vs Dedicated).
alex-eng: 99.99% on shared hosted is risky. Hosted: 99.9% realistic; 99.99% requires Dedicated pools + multi-region redundancy. Latency numbers depend on model and batching. Clarify: P99 100ms end-to-end for 512 tokens?
sarah-support: Jeff says end-to-end for typical generate calls <=512 tokens and must hold across peak traffic.
leo-ml: 100ms P99 is doable only on smaller models or heavy quantization. Large LM or long-context calls will push P99 much higher. Need perf estimates per model class.
maria-product: Actions: alex -> outline minimal Dedicated config to hit 99.99% + latency buckets. leo -> perf estimate matrix. jeff -> discuss options with MerchantCo and surface willingness to pilot. Who owns contract escalation routing? @ops-oncall?
ops-oncall: Proposed escalation: 1) platform alerts -> oncall -> 2) Dedicated ops team -> 3) eng pager. Can offer 30m initial response + 4h remediation SLA for Priority 1 under enterprise package. Phone support as add-on.
alex-eng: Sketch: 2x active regions, dedicated GPU pool with autoscale headroom, warm KV cache, health probes, prioritized routing. Estimated cost delta: +40-60% vs standard hosted for equivalent qps; will provide numbers.
jeff-sales: MerchantCo asked for sample clause. Quick draft below — legal to refine:
```
SLA: Provider will use commercially reasonable efforts to maintain 99.99% uptime for Dedicated instances. For Hosted tier, Provider guarantees 99.9% uptime. P99 latency guarantees apply to Dedicated instances for agreed model types and input size limits.
Support: 24/7 priority phone support for Priority 1 incidents with initial response within 30 minutes.
```
maria-product: Good start. Add rollback/fallback language: automatic routing to lower-latency model variants or reduced throughput QoS instead of hard failures. Legal will need to review outage credits and definitions.
sarah-support: MerchantCo prefers a hosted commitment. Can we offer a staged commitment: pilot on Dedicated for 3 months then scale to hosted SLA if metrics hold? Might close the deal.
alex-eng: Staged approach is safe. Commit to Dedicated SLA after a 3-month pilot with defined traffic patterns, test prompts, and SLO verification. Include canary deploy + traffic shaping in rollout plan.
leo-ml: I'll run the perf matrix and quantization options; aim to deliver by EOD tomorrow.
jeff-sales: Thanks. I'll tell MerchantCo we have a plan and will circulate a term-sheet once numbers are in.
maria-product: Owners: alex-eng (config + cost estimates), leo-ml (perf matrix), ops-oncall (escalation docs). Follow-up sync tomorrow 10:00am PT. :white_check_mark:
slo-bot: Ticket created: INC-4521 MerchantCo SLA intake. Assigned: maria-product, alex-eng, leo-ml.
maria-product: Added to roadmap intake board under 'enterprise-sla' with priority: high.
jeff-sales: Ping me when numbers are in and I'll get PO timeline from MerchantCo.
